blocks._note: The sheet picks the state, this picks the words. Officers should not have to keep 'we are full' consistent with whether a signup form is on screen underneath it — the hand-written page got exactly that wrong, saying lessons were full in one paragraph and open for snowboarders two paragraphs later.

not_yet_open.text: Registration for the {season_year} season is not open yet. [Join our mailing list](/join-our-mailing-list) and we will email you when it does.

open.text: Registration for the {season_year} season is open. Fill out the form below to sign up.

waitlist.text: Ski and snowboard lessons for the {season_year} season are full. Please fill out the form below to join the waitlist.

full.text: Ski and snowboard lessons for the {season_year} season are full, and the waitlist is closed. [Join our mailing list](/join-our-mailing-list) to hear about next season.
